name: Referral Link Tracker
author: epiphanyit321

sections.description:
Our WordPress plugin brings a streamlined solution for effortless URL tracking and URL generation. Crafted for an intuitive user experience, it seamlessly integrates into your workflow, enhancing link management with simplicity and efficiency. Optimize your site’s performance with comfort – a game-changer for tracking URL and generation!

A simple WordPress plugin that enhances your website’s functionality by adding a menu with two pages: Settings and Logs. The Log page is a powerful URL tracking tool that monitors newly generated URLs with parameters, capturing the user’s IP address. It provides a user-friendly interface with the functionality to delete individual rows and clear the entire log entries.

The Settings page empowers users to generate dynamic URLs for pages and posts effortlessly. It includes an advanced feature allowing the addition of URL parameters with five extra fields, such as source and value. The table on the Settings page presents a comprehensive list of tracked URLs, providing users with the flexibility to delete each row individually and copy the link with ease.

This plugin is create by Epiphany Infotech. We also provide complete Web Development, SEO and Digital Marketing services. Request a Free Quote for your website by visiting: https://www.epiphanyinfotech.com/

Key Features

  • Meticulous URL Tracking: The Log page effortlessly monitors and analyzes user engagement, providing valuable insights into your audience.

  • Dynamic URL Generation: The Settings page empowers users to create dynamic URLs for pages and posts, with the added flexibility of custom parameters.

  • Parameter Customization: The Settings page enables the addition of parameters with five extra fields, providing a tailored approach to URL generation.

  • IP Address Capture: Gain a deeper understanding of user activity through the capture of IP addresses.

  • User-Friendly Design: Manage and manipulate tracked URLs effortlessly through the Settings and Log pages.

Harness the power of this plugin to elevate your WordPress website’s URL management capabilities. Simplify tracking, enhance user engagement, and optimize your website’s performance effortlessly.

Curious about what others think? Explore reviews and testimonials on the plugin’s WordPress.org page to gain insights into real user experiences.

Short Description

Optimize your WordPress website’s link management with a seamless blend of functionality and user-friendly design. Effortlessly tracking URL and URL generation, capturing valuable insights into user activity.

sections.faq:
Q: Can I customize URLs generation?
A: Absolutely! The Settings page allows you to generate dynamic URLs for pages and posts. You can add parameters with five extra fields, providing a tailored approach to URL generation.

Q: Is it possible to delete tracked URLs?
A: Yes, both the Log and Settings pages provide the flexibility to manage tracked URLs. On the Settings page, you can delete each row individually, while the Log page allows you to delete individual rows or clear the entire log.

Q: Is there a limit to the number of URL parameters I can add when generating URLs?
A: To maintain optimal performance, the WordPress plugin allows the addition of up to five URL parameters when generating URLs. This balance ensures flexibility without compromising the user’s ability to comprehend and interact with the tracked URLs effectively.

Q: Are there any prerequisites for using this WordPress plugin?
A: The plugin requires WordPress version 3.0.1 or higher. Ensure your WordPress installation meets this requirement for optimal performance.

Redirect any query or report any bug you may find at: Epiphany Infotech
